sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Psycho Sniper is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello, mercenary. I had an acquaintance named Dima. He worked as a sniper in many hot zones. Once he told me: "Anyone can pull a trigger, but only a few can become a true Sniper". Even if that's true, knowing how to work with bolt-action rifles won't hurt in Tarkov. And I don't mind encouraging you to develop that skill. Take out your opponents, and I'll reward you for it."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text:
- Must be level 27 to start this quest.
- Must reach Loyalty Level 4 with Mechanic to obtain this quest.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate any 15 targets without dying while using a bolt-action rifle

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +65,000 EXP
- +4 Bolt-action Rifles skill levels
- +4 Troubleshooting skill levels
- Mechanic Rep +1.5
- 400,000 Roubles
  - 420,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 460,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- Unlocks purchase of 4.6x30mm FMJ SX at Mechanic LL4
- 3x 4.6x30mm FMJ SX ammo pack (40 pcs)
"Frankly speaking, i wasn't sure you could do it. But it sure seems that you're no regular pleb."

sections.heading: Failure Dialogue
sections.text: "An experienced sniper will not give himself away like that. Catch your breath and try again."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text: The kill objective can still fail through dying after completing it.
